scripts.text:
[Mungmung]
I'm not the innkeeper!
Why do people want to pay me when they see me?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
我可不是旅店老闆！
怎麼人人一見到我，就想塞錢給我？

scripts.text:
[Nemnem]
My pain is getting worse and worse
since the crevice appeared in Bifrost.
Are you responsible for it, young one?
scripts.translation:
[內姆內姆]
自從彩虹橋出現裂縫，我身上的病痛就一天比一天厲害。
年輕人，是不是你乾的？

scripts.text: Of course I am!
scripts.translation: 當然是我！

scripts.text: That's an unfair accusation!
scripts.translation: 這是冤枉人！

scripts.text:
[Nemnem]
Bra~vo!
scripts.translation:
[內姆內姆]
好~樣的！

scripts.text:
[Nemnem]
If not, never mind!
scripts.translation:
[內姆內姆]
如果不是，那就當我沒說！

scripts.text:
[Boaster]
So the situation
was at its worst.
scripts.translation:
[吹牛的人]
所以說，那時候情況已經糟透了。

scripts.text:
[Raffles]
Oh~!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾斯]
噢~！

scripts.text:
[Boaster]
Bored to death, I started to cry.
Then I fell asleep, tired from all the crying.
And when I woke up,
I was even more bored
than before!
scripts.translation:
[吹牛的人]
我無聊得要命，就哭了起來。
哭累了，我就睡著了。
誰知道一覺醒來，居然比之前還無聊！

scripts.text:
[Raffles]
Oh, oh!
That's terrible, so terrible.
How could that happen?!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾斯]
噢，噢！
太可怕了，太可怕了。
怎麼會發生這種事？！

scripts.text:
[Boaster]
So the situation got
more and more serious...
Now give me some more coins.
scripts.translation:
[吹牛的人]
所以，情況就越來越嚴重了...
來，再給我幾枚硬幣。

scripts.text:
[Rangrang]
I've never heard such a boring and sad story.
I feel like crying!
scripts.translation:
[朗朗]
我從沒聽過這麼無聊又悲傷的故事。
我都想哭了！

scripts.text:
[A Decoy]
Oh~!
That's just so
unbelievable!
I'm so curious, let's give him some coins!
scripts.translation:
[誘餌]
噢~！
這簡直太不可思議了！
我好想知道後面怎麼樣，我們再給他幾枚硬幣吧！

scripts.text:
[Moved Raffle]
This is sad, too sad!
I'm not sure why,
but it must be sad
because everybody else says so.
scripts.translation:
[感動的拉弗爾]
太慘了，真是太慘了！
我也不知道為什麼，不過大家都說慘，那一定很慘。

scripts.text:
[Relieved Raffle]
Wow~!
This is exciting.
He woke up safe and sound again!
Well, I'm sure he will next time!
...
scripts.translation:
[鬆了口氣的拉弗爾]
哇~！真刺激。
他又平平安安地醒過來了！
下回肯定也能醒！
...

scripts.text:
[Relieved Raffle]
Eh?
scripts.translation:
[鬆了口氣的拉弗爾]
咦？

scripts.text:
[Excited Raffle]
Wow~
The story is no fun at all.
Wow~!
But it's as if we were singing in chorus -
it's really fun.
Wow~!
scripts.translation:
[興奮的拉弗爾]
哇~故事一點兒也不好玩。
哇~！可大家這樣一唱一和的，倒是很好玩。
哇~！

scripts.text:
[Impressed Raffle]
Wow! Wow!
scripts.translation:
[佩服的拉弗爾]
哇！哇！

scripts.text:
[Visitor to Mora]
I'm stuck here because of the crevice, which appeared out of nowhere.
Ha......
scripts.translation:
[穆拉的訪客]
突然冒出這麼條裂縫，把我困在這兒了。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Visitor to Mora]
Isn't this one cheerful village?
With Bifrost blocked like that, I'm thinking of settling here permanently.
scripts.translation:
[穆拉的訪客]
這村子挺熱鬧的吧？
彩虹橋堵成那樣，我都想幹脆在這兒定居了。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I heard that somebody made it out of the Labyrinth Forest alive.
Whoever it is, I want to meet this person myself.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
聽說有人活著走出了迷藏森林。
不管是誰，我都想親眼見見。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
I'll come out of the Labyrinth Forest and become a hero!
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
我要走出迷藏森林，成為英雄！

scripts.text:
[Indifferent Worker]
I hear somebody already did that.
scripts.translation:
[冷漠的工人]
我聽說已經有人做到了。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
What if I say I'm that somebody?
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
如果我說那個人就是我呢？

scripts.text:
[Indifferent Worker]
Forget it. It's more believable
to say I did it.
scripts.translation:
[冷漠的工人]
得了吧，說是我做到的，還比你可信點。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
Well, that's true.
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
嗯，確實是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
I'll come out of the Labyrinth Forest and become a hero!
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
我要走出迷藏森林，成為英雄！

scripts.text:
[Indifferent Worker]
I hear somebody already did that.
scripts.translation:
[冷漠的工人]
我聽說已經有人做到了。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
What if I say I'm that somebody?
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
如果我說那個人就是我呢？

scripts.text:
[Indifferent Worker]
Forget it. It's more believable
to say I did it.
scripts.translation:
[冷漠的工人]
得了吧，說是我做到的，還比你可信點。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
Well, that's true.
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
嗯，確實是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Stay clear of the Labyrinth Forest.
Don't ever dream of peeking in out of curiosity.
Lots of travelers have gone missing after going there.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
離迷藏森林遠一點。
千萬別因為好奇就想進去看看。
很多旅行者進去之後就失蹤了。

scripts.text:
[Relaxing Rafflesia]
The public bath in the center of the village is a symbol of Mora Village.
scripts.translation:
[悠閒的草精]
村子中央的公共浴池是穆拉村的象徵。

scripts.text:
[Relaxing Rafflesia]
It's not just a simple puddle.
It has tremendous power
to heal wounds.
scripts.translation:
[悠閒的草精]
那可不是普通的水坑，它有很強的療傷功效。

scripts.text:
[Relaxing Rafflesia]
Try walking in the bath
if you want to see for yourself.
It will slowly but surely heal your wounds.
scripts.translation:
[悠閒的草精]
不信就走進浴池裡試試。
傷口會慢慢癒合，效果可是實打實的。

scripts.text:
[Shortffle]
I want to climb the ladder,
but my legs are too short to do that.
scripts.translation:
[矮拉弗爾]
我想爬梯子，可是我的腿太短，爬不上去。

scripts.text:
[Shortffle]
I wonder who brought it here.
scripts.translation:
[矮拉弗爾]
不知道是誰把梯子搬到這裡來的。

scripts.text:
You see a Rafflesia
lost in reading.
scripts.translation: 你看到一朵草精正沉浸在閱讀中。

scripts.text: See what he's reading.
scripts.translation: 看看它在讀什麼

scripts.text: Leave him alone.
scripts.translation: 別打擾它

scripts.text:
Curious about what he's reading,
you quietly approach him from behind.
The Rafflesia is reading in a low voice.
scripts.translation:
你好奇它在讀什麼，悄悄從背後靠近。
草精正在低聲朗讀。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren was going to Eremes's.
He was going there to borrow
Eremes's reference books,
scripts.translation:
[讀書的草精]
塞倫正要去艾勒梅斯家，向他借些參考書。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
but he also hoped to see
his beautiful sister, Seiren.
Seiren knocked on Eremes's door
with his heart pounding.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的草精]
不過，他還盼著見一見艾勒梅斯那位美麗的妹妹塞倫。
塞倫心怦怦直跳，敲響了艾勒梅斯家的門。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Knock! Knock! Knock!
Excuse me. Is anybody there?
... ... ...
He doesn't hear anything.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的草精]
咚！咚！咚！
打擾了。有人在家嗎？
... ... ...
他什麼也沒聽到。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Is there nobody home?
He knocked again,
afraid that he might have
made the trip for nothing.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的草精]
難道沒人在家？
他擔心自己白跑一趟，又敲了一次門。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Knock! Knock! Knock!
No answer again. Is there nobody home?
He knew it was rude to do that,
but he decided to enter anyway
and wait for Eremes to come back home.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的草精]
咚！咚！咚！
還是沒人應聲。難道沒人在家？
他知道這樣很失禮，但還是決定進屋等艾勒梅斯回來。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren opened the front door
with his heart throbbing.
*squeak*
The door wasn't locked.
Eremes seems to be away for a while.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的草精]
塞倫心怦怦直跳，推開了前門。
*吱呀*
門沒鎖，看來艾勒梅斯暫時不在家。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren entered the house hesitantly.
The moment he stepped into the house,
he heard a sound of water running.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的草精]
塞倫猶猶豫豫地走進屋裡。
剛踏進屋內，他就聽到了流水聲。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren suddenly came to his senses,
and turned back to go out.
But right at the moment!!
scripts.translation:
[讀書的草精]
塞倫突然回過神來，轉身想要出去。
但就在這一瞬間！！

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
*thud*
The bathroom door opened,
and with white steam pouring out came a foot.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的草精]
*砰*
浴室門開了，白色水汽湧出，一隻腳邁了出來。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren's heart almost stopped
at the sight of it. And a moment later,
somebody came out from the bathroom,
with just a towel around her body.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的草精]
塞倫看到這一幕，心都快停跳了。
片刻後，一名身上只裹著浴巾的女子從浴室裡走了出來。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
With her body still wet
from the shower...
scripts.translation:
[讀書的草精]
她的身體還帶著剛洗完澡的水珠...

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
*gasp* Who are you? How long
were you standing there? How rude.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的草精]
*嘶*
你是誰？在那兒站多久了？
太沒禮貌了！

scripts.text:
The Rafflesia closed the book hastily.
You're curious what will happen next,
but you've been rude enough,
so you just give up.
scripts.translation:
草精慌忙合上了書。
你很好奇接下來會發生什麼，但你已經夠失禮了，只好作罷。

scripts.text:
You leave the place quietly
in order not to disturb
the Rafflesia, who was lost in reading.
scripts.translation: 為了不打擾看書入迷的草精，你悄悄離開了。

scripts.text:
[Banana Rafflesia]
You want a banana?
scripts.translation:
[香蕉草精]
你想要香蕉嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 好，我要

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Banana Rafflesia]
Take it if you can.
If you are successful, you can have it for free.
scripts.translation:
[香蕉草精]
有本事就來拿吧。
如果拿到了，就免費送你。

scripts.text:
[Banana Rafflesia]
Well, I was going to give it for free,
but if you don't want it, it's fine with me.
scripts.translation:
[香蕉草精]
本來是想免費送你的，不過你不要就算了。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
The Mora Inn is famous
for its unusual pieces of furniture.
Mushroom closets and apple dressers...
Aren't they so innovative?
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
穆拉旅館以獨特的傢俱而聞名。
蘑菇衣櫃、蘋果梳妝檯...
是不是很有創意？

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Sorry... maybe it's just me...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
抱歉...也許只有我這麼覺得...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
The Rafflesia in Mora Village all look alike, so it's so confusing.
It's like looking at centuplets...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
穆拉村的草精長得都一個樣，真讓人分不清。
就像在看百胞胎一樣...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
However! If you look closely,
you'll find each of them has a personality.
To find it is one of the fun things
you can do in the village.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
不過！仔細瞧瞧，就會發現它們各有各的個性。
分辨這些差別，也是逛村子的樂趣之一。

scripts.text:
[Wounded Raffle]
Ugghh... What was it
that was in the bath... Arrrghh...
To attack suddenly like that... Be careful...
Whatever it is in there, it's very aggressive.
scripts.translation:
[受傷的拉弗爾]
嗚呃...浴池裡那到底是什麼...啊啊...
居然突然撲過來...當心點...
不管那是什麼，兇得很。

scripts.text:
[Lively]
The inn over there~
It should've been mine~
scripts.translation:
[活潑]
那邊的旅館~
本該是我的~

scripts.text:
[Lively]
The store over there~
It should've been mine as well~
scripts.translation:
[活潑]
那邊的商店~
也本該是我的~

scripts.text:
[Lively]
The warehouse here~
and all the things in it~
All of those should've been mine~
All of those should've been mine~
scripts.translation:
[活潑]
這裡的倉庫和裡面的東西~
本來都該是我的~
本來都該是我的~

scripts.text:
[Lively]
Ahhh... I'd like to make money...
scripts.translation:
[活潑]
啊啊...真想賺點錢啊...

scripts.text:
[Kuorita]
Oh... this duck...
scripts.translation:
[庫奧裡塔]
噢...這隻鴨子...

scripts.text:
[Kuorita]
Its slender red beak...
and the blush on its cheeks...
and its wings, ready to take off
any moment...
scripts.translation:
[庫奧裡塔]
它細長的紅色鳥喙...
臉頰上的紅暈...
還有隨時準備起飛的翅膀...

scripts.text:
[Kuorita]
I want to have it badly...
What would happen if I stole it?
scripts.translation:
[庫奧裡塔]
我真的很想要它...
如果我把它偷走會怎樣？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
With a little token of appreciation, I will tell you a quote that will help you in your life.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
只要給我一點謝禮，我就送你一句對人生有幫助的名言。

scripts.text: Give him a token of appreciation.
scripts.translation: 給他一點謝禮

scripts.text: Can't you just tell me?
scripts.translation: 不能直接告訴我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
You don't get something for nothing.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
天下沒有免費的午餐。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
How much are you willing to give me?
You can pay me in the currencies listed below.
Enter the sum you're willing to pay. Enter 0 if you don't want to pay anything.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
你願意給多少？
下面列出的貨幣都能用。
輸入你願意付的金額，不想付就輸入0。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
So you don't want to hear a quote, eh?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
這麼說，你不想聽名言了？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
You can pay between ^FF0000100 and 1000000^000000.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
你可以支付^FF0000100到1000000^000000之間的金額。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
So you think this is what my time is worth?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
你覺得我的時間就值這麼點？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
The quote I'm going to tell you is...
Let's see... Wait a second.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
我要告訴你的名言是...
讓我想想...稍等一下。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
Okay! I think this is the one for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
好了！我覺得這句最適合你。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Nothing is more difficult,
and therefore more precious,
than to be able to decide.
- Napoleon Bonaparte -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
沒有什麼比作出決定更困難，因此也沒有什麼比這更可貴。
- 拿破崙·波拿巴 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Sometimes we stare so long at a door that is closing,
that we see too late the one that is open.
- Alexander Graham Bell -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
有時我們盯著一扇正在關閉的門太久，等注意到另一扇敞開的門時，已經太晚了。
- 亞歷山大·格拉漢姆·貝爾 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
If it's that painful, why do you keep doing it?
The answer's simple.
Because it makes my heart beat,
because it excites me.
My body might suffer, but I'm a lot happier
doing what I have always wanted to do.
- Biya Han -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
既然那麼辛苦，為什麼還要繼續？
答案很簡單。
因為它讓我心跳加速，因為它讓我興奮。
身體也許會受苦，但做自己一直想做的事，讓我快樂得多。
- 韓飛野 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
You cannot persuade anybody
before you change yourself.
- Cheoljong Ko -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
在改變自己之前，你無法說服任何人。
- 高哲宗 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Never regret what you have chosen.
- Miyoung Ko -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
不要後悔你所做出的選擇。
- 高美英 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
A man is not finished when he is defeated.
He is finished when he quits.
- Richard Nixon -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
人被打敗時並沒有完蛋，放棄時才真正完蛋。
- 理查德·尼克松 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Failure is instructive.
The person who really thinks
learns quite as much from his failures
as from his successes.
- John Dewey -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
失敗能給人以教益。
真正善於思考的人，從失敗中學到的東西，並不比從成功中學到的少。
- 約翰·杜威 -

[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
我們播種思想，收穫行動；
我們播種行動，收穫習慣；
我們播種習慣，收穫性格；
我們播種性格，收穫命運。
- 伊拉斯謨 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...

scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
沒哭過的年輕人是野蠻人，不肯笑的老年人是傻瓜。
- 喬治·桑塔亞那 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
I do not have much patience
with a thing of beauty
that must be explained
to be understood.
If it does need additional interpretation
then I question
whether it has fulfilled its purpose.
- Charlie Chaplin -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
對於那種必須經過解釋才能被理解的美，我沒有多少耐心。
如果它確實需要額外的詮釋，我就會懷疑它是否達到了它的目的。
- 查理·卓別林 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Life is a tragedy
when seen in close-up,
but a comedy
in long-shot.
- Charlie Chaplin -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
人生近看是悲劇，遠看是喜劇。
- 查理·卓別林 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
The clearest sign of wisdom is continued cheerfulness.
- Michel de Montaigne -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
智慧最鮮明的標誌，是常懷喜悅。
- 米歇爾·德·蒙田 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
The time you enjoyed wasting
was not wasted.
- John Lennon -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
只要樂在其中，時光便沒有白白流逝。
- 約翰·列儂 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
True humor springs not more from the head than from the heart.
It is not contempt; its essence is love.
It issues not in laughter,
but in still smiles, which lie far deeper.
- Thomas Carlyle -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
真正的幽默與其說源於頭腦，不如說源於心靈。
它不是輕蔑，本質卻是愛。
它流露於意味深長的淺笑，而非放聲大笑。
- 托馬斯·卡萊爾 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Through humor, you can soften
some of the worst blows
that life delivers.
And once you find laughter,
no matter how painful
your situation might be,
you can survive it.
- Bill Cosby -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
通過幽默，你可以減輕人生中一些最沉重的打擊。
一旦你找到了笑聲，無論處境多麼痛苦，你都能熬過去。
- 比爾·科斯比 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
My great hope is to laugh
as much as I cry;
to get my work done
and try to love somebody
and have the courage
to accept the love in return.
- Maya Angelou -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
我最大的希望是笑得和哭得一樣多；完成我的工作，試著去愛一個人，並有勇氣接受對方的愛。
- 瑪雅·安吉洛 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
People take what they hear
differently.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
每個人對聽到的話都有不同的理解。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
I wonder what you think
about what I've told you.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
不知道你對我說的話有什麼看法。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
So you think that {0}.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
所以你認為{0}。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
... ... ... ...

[Raffle Philosopher]
I don't know. There is no one answer
to this question...
Hold onto your thought.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
我也不知道。這個問題沒有唯一的答案...
堅持你的想法吧。

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
You... you dare play a game with me?
scripts.translation:
[心煩的旅行者]
你...你竟敢跟我玩這種把戲？

scripts.text:
[Traveler That Posed the Question]
What...? Do you have proof?
Do you have proof?!!
scripts.translation:
[提問的旅行者]
什...什麼？你有證據嗎？
你有證據嗎？！！

scripts.text:
[Traveler Trying to Stop the Fight]
Look, stop it, just stop it!
I'm afraid it will turn into a big fight...
scripts.translation:
[勸架的旅行者]
喂，別吵了，快停下！
再這樣下去，怕是要大打出手了...

scripts.text:
[Traveler Trying to Stop the Fight]
Oh! Why don't we ask
that person there...?
scripts.translation:
[勸架的旅行者]
噢！我們要不問問那邊那個人...？

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
Oh, yes! That's a great idea.
Well~ Hello there~
You there, traveler!
scripts.translation:
[心煩的旅行者]
噢，對！這是個好主意。
嘿~你好呀~
那邊那位，旅行者！

scripts.text: They seem to be calling out to you.
scripts.translation: 他們好像在叫你。

scripts.text: See what the matter is.
scripts.translation: 看看發生了什麼事

scripts.text: I have nothing to do with it.
scripts.translation: 與我無關

scripts.text:
You went on your way
leaving the travelers behind you.
scripts.translation: 你丟下那些旅行者，繼續趕路了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's happening here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
I'll tell you what.
Rose's mother had 10 sons.
The eldest son is called Roseone,
the second Rosetwo,
the third Rosethree...
the ninth Rosenine...
you get how it works, right?
scripts.translation:
[心煩的旅行者]
我跟你說。
蘿絲的媽媽有10個兒子。
老大叫蘿絲一，老二叫蘿絲二，老三叫蘿絲三...老九叫蘿絲九...
你明白規律了吧？

scripts.text:
[Traveler That Posed the Question]
Right, that's how it works.
So I asked what the youngest one would be called,
and when I told him the answer,
he got all upset and started cursing me.
scripts.translation:
[提問的旅行者]
對，就是這麼排的。
我就問他最小的兒子叫什麼。
誰知道告訴他答案後，他就急了，還開口罵我。

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
You... you bastard!
Hey there, what do you think
the answer to the question is?
scripts.translation:
[心煩的旅行者]
你...你這個混蛋！
喂，你說這個問題的答案是什麼？

scripts.text: Roseten.
scripts.translation: 蘿絲十

scripts.text: Rose.
scripts.translation: 蘿絲

scripts.text: How would I know that?
scripts.translation: 我怎麼知道？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The answer to the question is Roseten.
Why are you fighting over such a trivial matter?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
答案是蘿絲十。
你們怎麼為這點小事吵起來了？

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
See? Even this traveler says
Roseten is the answer.
How dare you try to play tricks on me?
scripts.translation:
[心煩的旅行者]
看吧？連這位旅行者都說答案是蘿絲十。
你竟敢耍我？

scripts.text:
[Traveler That Posed the Question]
You idiot... you don't have the slightest clue!
scripts.translation:
[提問的旅行者]
你這個笨蛋...你根本什麼都不懂！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The answer to the question is Rose.
You said Rose's mother had 10 sons.
So even if the other sons' names are
Roseone, Rosetwo, ... Rosenine,
the youngest one must be Rose,
or she wouldn't be called Rose's mother.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
答案是蘿絲。
你說蘿絲的媽媽有10個兒子。
所以就算其他兒子叫蘿絲一、蘿絲二...蘿絲九，最小的那個也一定叫蘿絲，不然她就不會被叫作蘿絲的媽媽了。

scripts.text:
[Traveler That Posed the Question]
That's exactly what I mean!
I can't hang around with him.
I guess we live in two different worlds.
scripts.translation:
[提問的旅行者]
對，我就是這個意思！
跟這人真處不來，簡直活在兩個世界。

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
You bastard... What did you
get from this guy...?
scripts.translation:
[心煩的旅行者]
你這混蛋...你從這傢伙那裡拿了什麼好處...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have no idea.
Try to sort it out yourselves.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也不知道。
你們自己解決吧。

scripts.text:
[Traveler Trying to Stop the Fight]
You good-for-nothing bastard,
you're trying to leave this mess to me?
scripts.translation:
[勸架的旅行者]
你這個沒用的混蛋，想把這爛攤子丟給我？

scripts.text:
*thud*
You feel a sudden impact on the back of your head.
Your sight is going blurry.
scripts.translation:
*砰*
你感到後腦勺突然捱了一下。
你的視線漸漸模糊。

scripts.text: You feel somebody rummaging through your pockets before you pass out.
scripts.translation: 在失去意識之前，你感覺到有人在翻你的口袋。

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Phew~ Phew~
scripts.translation:
[穆拉村民]
呼~呼~

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Snore...
scripts.translation:
[穆拉村民]
呼嚕...

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Snort--
scripts.translation:
[穆拉村民]
呼哧——

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Snort--
scripts.translation:
[穆拉村民]
呼哧——

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Moan...
scripts.translation:
[穆拉村民]
唔...

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Phew phew pheeew~
scripts.translation:
[穆拉村民]
呼，呼，呼——~

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
z Z
scripts.translation:
[穆拉村民]
呼嚕...

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
z Z
scripts.translation:
[穆拉村民]
呼嚕...

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
z Z
scripts.translation:
[穆拉村民]
呼嚕...

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Oh~ looks like we have another adventurer.
Where are you from?
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
哦~又來了一位冒險者。
你從哪兒來啊？

scripts.text: Just save the game.
scripts.translation: 只要存檔

scripts.text: I'd like to get some rest.
scripts.translation: 我想休息一下

scripts.text: The place I used to live is called...
scripts.translation: 我以前住的地方叫...

scripts.text: How can I use the warehouse?
scripts.translation: 如何使用倉庫？

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Wow, what's the rush?
You've just come here, and you're already going someplace else?
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
哇，這麼著急？
你才剛來，就要去別的地方了？

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
You know, haste makes waste. Tsk tsk.
Well, the game's been saved.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
俗話說，欲速則不達。嘖嘖。
好了，已經幫你存檔了。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
My my, I need some rest also.
The rate is 5000 zeny. Do you want a room?
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
哎呀，我也想歇一歇呢。
房費5000 Zeny，要住嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
The rate is 5000z.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
房費是5000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Make yourself at home.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
請把這裡當自己家吧。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
If you don't have the money, go soak yourself in the puddle in the center of the village.
It will warm you up.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
沒錢的話，就去村子中央的水池裡泡一泡吧。
那樣也能暖和起來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I come from a place called {1}.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我來自一個叫{1}的地方。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Oh, I think I've heard about the place before!
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
哦，我好像聽說過那個地方！

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
I heard there's an old tower where horrible witches put Savages in a giant cauldron and cast evil spells on them, right?
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
聽說那裡有一座古老的塔，可怕的女巫們把野豬丟進巨大的鍋裡，對它們施加邪惡的咒語，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
What's worse is that whoever takes medicine made out of Savages will come back for more!
And he will wander around looking for the tower, and eventually turn into an enormous Savage!
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
更可怕的是，吃了用野豬做的藥的人，還會想再吃！
他會四處遊蕩尋找那座塔，最後變成一頭巨大的野豬！

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
I heard that there are creeps there who won't get up at all even if it rains or snows, or their sweethearts or parents call them!
And that black clouds hover over them all the time, causing a storm!
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
聽說那裡還有些怪人，不管下雨下雪，還是戀人、父母來叫，都不肯起來！
他們頭上還總是烏雲密佈，颳風下雨！

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
How terrible!
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
太可怕了！

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Search through the vegetable-shaped drawer to my right.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
去翻翻我右邊那個蔬菜形狀的抽屜吧。

scripts.text: - You don't remember how to open the warehouse. -
scripts.translation: - 你不記得怎麼開啟倉庫了。 -

scripts.text: - The figure 1 0 0 is written in small letters on the vegetable-shaped drawer. -
scripts.translation: - 蔬菜形狀的抽屜上用小字寫著數字 1 0 0。 -

scripts.text: Insert 100 zeny.
scripts.translation: 投入100 Zeny

scripts.text: Don't do anything.
scripts.translation: 什麼都不做

scripts.text: - You don't seem to have 100 zeny with you. -
scripts.translation: - 你身上好像沒有100 Zeny。 -

scripts.text: - You gave up using the warehouse. -
scripts.translation: - 你放棄了使用倉庫。 -
